content.comment_body: I am attempting to send counter values to AWS. After searching here, I tried replicating the suggested method for transferring counter values to Modbus, but I have not succeeded so far. Parameter VM Mapping: B001 [Up/Down Counter] - Counter - DWord - 0. Online Settings: Data transfer settings - VW - VW0 - Word - 1 - 1s. I would appreciate some assistance. Thank you.
Hello, as you mentioned, the counter value is a double word. Therefore, you need to transfer two words to AWS. DW equals 2VW, which is 4 bytes. Hope this helps!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to export counter values from their [company_name] system to AWS. The current method uses VW (Word) mapping, but since the counter is actually a double word (DW), correct data type mapping is necessary. Users are facing difficulties handling data type compatibility and setting up cloud data transfer, highlighting a lack of clear documentation or examples for this scenario.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward guidance or native support for sending double word counter values to cloud platforms such as AWS, desiring clear and easy-to-follow instructions suitable for these use cases.
